title: End-of-Game Two-Point Situation
description: Down by one or two points with little time left, the team practises getting a clean shot at the rim rather than settling for a contested outside look.

content.objective: Get a high-percentage shot at the rim in a late-game, down-by-one-or-two situation rather than forcing a tough outside shot.
content.setup: A live 5v5 possession starts with a simulated scoreboard: down by one or two points with under ten seconds left.
instructions: The offense runs a called set designed to get a shot close to the rim.
Players read the defense and take the first clean look at the rim rather than passing it up.
If the rim shot isn't there, the backup option is a good, in-rhythm outside shot.
Reset with a new simulated time and score each rep.
coachingPoints: Prioritise the highest-percentage shot available, not just any shot.
Keep calm decision-making even with the clock running down.
Know the backup option before the possession even starts.
commonMistakes: Forcing a contested outside shot when a cleaner rim shot was actually there.
Panicking and rushing a decision well before the clock actually demands it.
Losing focus on the details once the simulated pressure is on.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled during the live possession.
